**PotentialBreaks 1.3.0**

- **SAVE KIT**: one tap saves the 16 pads as a real **MPC drum program**: each pad as a WAV, as you hear it (at your tempo, pitch and shuffle), on pads A01-A16, with the groove as a MIDI file beside it. Load it like any program, and keep it after the plugin is gone. It goes to `PotentialBreaks/Kits` on your breaks' drive, or to the folder named on the first line of `PotentialBreaks/kit-folder.txt` there. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1 or later (the program format it writes).
- The DIG panel has room for it: RANDOM BREAK on top, then SAVE KIT, SAVE GROOVE, PLAY LOOP and RESCAN.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.3.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialbreaks/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.3.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.3.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialBreaks-1.3.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialbreaks/issues/new/choose).
